text: {"assertions":["A loss divergence issue in ml/train/loop.py occurred only on the first request after a cold start.","The root cause was schema drift between the migration and the model.","The issue was characterized by a loss curve that turns upward and never returns.","The fix involved regenerating the model from the migration and pinning the checksum.","The fix was submitted as PR #3597 on branch fix/loss-divergence-1.","The fix was verified by training two epochs on the small split.","After the fix, the nightly rollup matched source counts for 41 consecutive days."]}
